name: Office window
description: Big round-cornered white frame with a chunky cross mullion, deep sill ledge and one glass pane
mount: wall opening: origin at the bottom centre of the 2.2 x 1.5 m main window opening (sill 0.95, head 2.45), centred in the 0.3 m wall. Place at wallPoint(side, mid, 0.95); scale X for other bay widths. Transom at 55 % of the height.
notes: Glass material is 'Glass' (alpha 0.35); swap it for the game's glare glass by name.
